text:
Asking rents in Dortmund stand at a median of 9.70 €/m² (2026-06), up 2.4% on the year and +23.2% over five years. That ranks Dortmund #29 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 50% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.45 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 582 € a month in cold rent, 14.4% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 33 days and 22% are gone within a week; with 2.1% market-active vacancy and +1.3% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.31 €/m² (+6.2%), with an 80% range of 10.02 to 10.52 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
